starts without this one's messages.

with the input.

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

# Construct and validate the proposed 20x29 output grid.
G=[[4]*29 for _ in range(20)]
# 9 frame, interior side 5 -> fill 7
for c in range(1,8): G[1][c]=G[7][c]=9
for r in range(2,7): G[r][1]=G[r][7]=9
for r in range(2,7):
    for c in range(2,7): G[r][c]=7
# 9 frame, interior side 6 -> fill 2
for c in range(20,28): G[4][c]=G[11][c]=9
for r in range(5,11): G[r][20]=G[r][27]=9
for r in range(5,11):
    for c in range(21,27): G[r][c]=2
# 5 frame, interior side 2 -> fill 2
for c in range(1,5): G[11][c]=G[14][c]=5
for r in (12,13): G[r][1]=G[r][4]=5
for r in (12,13):
    for c in (2,3): G[r][c]=2
# 6 frame, interior side 3 -> fill 7
for c in range(12,17): G[12][c]=G[16][c]=6
for r in range(13,16): G[r][12]=G[r][16]=6
for r in range(13,16):
    for c in range(13,16): G[r][c]=7
assert len(G)==20 and all(len(row)==29 for row in G)
import json
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':G}))
